privacidad.title: Privacy
paragraphs: The form prepares your message in your browser. When you continue to WhatsApp, the app receives the prefilled message so you can review it before sending. This site does not store inquiries in a database.

Your browser requests your location when you choose “Get directions from my location.” If Google Maps has a verified destination, you can open directions there using your location as the starting point. If you choose Waze, its app handles navigation.
The map loads streets from a mapping provider. WhatsApp, Waze, Google Maps, and the mapping provider each handle their own data processing.
The site keeps your theme and language preferences in your browser’s local storage.

cookies.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This site runs without first-party cookies or analytics tools. When you open an external service, its privacy settings apply.

Noise that seems to come from the alternator.

arrancador.repairIntro: Tell us what happens when you try to start the vehicle. The sound, cranking speed, and how often it happens help explain the issue.
